sources.title: Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard: How to Achieve Superperformance in Stocks in Any Market
sources.author: Mark Minervini
sources.accessible_reference: Library of Congress / Major Academic & Business Libraries
sources.claim_scope: Foundational specification of Volatility Contraction Pattern (VCP), Trend Template, Stage 2 criteria, and pivot mechanics.

claims.supported_claim: A volatility contraction pattern is a constructive price consolidation where price volatility narrows through a succession of contractions (waves) accompanied by drying volume, leading to supply exhaustion.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Pattern concept, consolidation wave narrowing, volume contraction.

claims.supported_claim: Minervini 8-point trend template requires: 1) Price > 150 & 200 SMA; 2) 150 SMA > 200 SMA; 3) 200 SMA trending up >= 1 mo; 4) 50 SMA > 150 & 200 SMA; 5) Price > 50 SMA; 6) Price >= 30% above 52w low; 7) Price within 25% of 52w high; 8) Relative strength rank >= 70.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Macro uptrend verification prior to consolidation.

claims.supported_claim: Each successive contraction wave exhibits a smaller percentage depth than the previous wave (e.g., 25% then 15% then 8% then 3%).
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Mathematical depth contraction sequence: Depth_k < Depth_{k-1}.

claims.supported_claim: Volume contracts significantly during pullbacks within the base and dries up substantially on the final contraction, indicating seller exhaustion.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Declining daily volume compared to historical moving average.

claims.supported_claim: The pivot is the optimal entry point, defined by the resistance high of the final narrowest contraction wave ('cheat' or handle high), where risk can be mathematically bounded.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Exact price level triggering actionable breakout with tight stop.

claims.supported_claim: A constructive base must be preceded by a prior primary advance of at least +30% to +100% or greater to qualify as continuation rather than random noise.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Prior trend minimum velocity and magnitude.

claims.supported_claim: Typically consists of 2 to 4 contractions (denoted 2T, 3T, 4T); rarely up to 6T. Base duration spans 2 to 45 weeks.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Discrete wave counting and consolidation duration limits.

sources.title: Think & Trade Like a Champion: The Secrets, Rules & Blunt Truths of a Stock Market Wizard
sources.author: Mark Minervini
sources.accessible_reference: Library of Congress / Public & Academic Collections
sources.claim_scope: Detailed execution mechanics: cheat pivots, cheat entries, risk-to-reward ratios, and stop placement.

claims.supported_claim: The 'Cheat' area is a high-handle or pause in the upper third of the base that allows an early entry before the ultimate multi-month base breakout.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Early pivot identification and tactical entry execution.

claims.supported_claim: A setup is invalidated if the breakout reverses below the pivot level or breaches the stop loss floor (typically 5% to 8% max loss).
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Invalidation criteria post-breakout.

sources.title: Secrets for Profiting in Bull and Bear Markets
sources.author: Stan Weinstein
sources.claim_scope: Authoritative 4-Stage market lifecycle: Stage 1 (Basing), Stage 2 (Advancing), Stage 3 (Topping), Stage 4 (Declining).

claims.supported_claim: Stage 1 Basing Area: The asset moves sideways in a consolidation range following a major decline; 30-week (150/200 day) MA flattens.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Dormant accumulation base, flat moving average.

claims.supported_claim: Stage 2 Advancing Phase: Breakout above resistance of Stage 1 base on heavy volume; price trades above rising 30-week / 200-day moving average.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Secular uptrend, expanding volume on rallies, higher highs and higher lows.

claims.supported_claim: Stage 3 The Top Area: Upward momentum stalls; volume is often heavy with churning; 30-week / 200-day moving average flattens and price dips below it.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Distribution, flattening moving average, high volatility.

claims.supported_claim: Stage 4 The Declining Phase: Breakdown below Stage 3 support; price trades below declining 30-week / 200-day moving average; avoid or short.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Markdown, secular downtrend, lower highs and lower lows.

sources.title: How to Make Money in Stocks: A Winning System in Good Times and Bad, 4th Edition
sources.author: William J. O'Neil
sources.claim_scope: Cup-with-Handle, base duration, volume dry-up, institutional accumulation signatures.

claims.supported_claim: Constructive basing patterns require minimum 7 weeks of consolidation (or 3-4 weeks for flat bases) with quiet, dried-up volume on the lows.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Base duration and handle volume behavior.

claims.supported_claim: A breakout occurs when price crosses above pivot resistance on volume expanding by at least 40% to 50% above the 50-day average volume.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Breakout confirmation volume threshold.

sources.title: ARX Terminal Quantitative VCP & Stage Operationalization Specification
sources.author: ARX Research & Architecture Team
sources.claim_scope: Algorithmic operationalization of qualitative discretionary VCP criteria into deterministic computational predicates.

claims.supported_claim: A candidate contraction is an algorithmic wave bounded by a local peak and subsequent trough detected using a rolling peak-detection window over daily OHLCV.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Deterministic wave segment identification.

claims.supported_claim: A candidate contraction is valid if its depth is >= 2% and <= 45%, and duration is >= 4 trading sessions.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Threshold bounds for noise elimination.

claims.supported_claim: State assigned when historical price/volume data is fewer than required lookback sessions (200 sessions for Trend Template, 50 for volume).
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Fail-closed evaluation state.

claims.supported_claim: State assigned when data is complete but ambiguous market structure prevents affirmative classification under frozen predicates.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Fail-closed evaluation state.

claims.supported_claim: State assigned to predicates that are conditional on predecessor criteria that failed.
claims.exact_interpretive_scope: Conditional evaluation bypass.
